The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the left tail lamp assembly is
shattered, with scuffing and a crushed reinforcement bar that line up with a straight

prior collision work on this vehicle. The plan is to replace the bumper cover, tail
lamp, and reinforcement bar, then refinish the rear panel and recalibrate the parking
sensors. The laobr hours listed fit the scope of this damage, and the invoices
